authorities: G4-07 Rev0.1: optical GET CONFIGURATION conditional selected local drive; 4 devices, 4MiB each, 8MiB source, 8sec/device and 20sec source, one-run consent, possible spin-up; no eject/read/rip.
Pinned G5-03 o1.py and o1_execution.py: vetted sg_get_config --readonly --current /dev/srN; sealed callNNNN-stdout/stderr, actual exit, no automatic privilege.
Pinned G5-04 _verified_o1_provenance requires in-memory witness, matching sealed SRC-17 same-run D0 source, consent, fixed argv and hash.

External sg_get_config manpage https://man.archlinux.org/man/extra/sg3_utils/sg_get_config.8.en and utility's open-source decoder output https://fossies.org/dox/sg3_utils-1.49/sg__get__config_8c_source.html

expected.grammar: Successful stdout contains at most one leading 'Current profile: <reported description>' line, then literal 'Features:' line and bounded following opaque feature/descriptor text; no current profile can be printed on stderr, not inferred from stdout absence. No media-presence verdict from profiles.
expected.result: One private OBJECT datum optical.mmc.current_configuration with reported_profile optional STRING and feature_lines array of opaque original decoded lines; retain order, no profile-to-device health/media inference.
expected.provenance: Only verified original callNNNN-stdout of SRC-18 with same-run authentic O1 witness, exact fixed command, selected /dev/srN target and corresponding sealed SRC-17 optical path. stderr diagnostic-only.
expected.status: CAPTURED can be COMPLETE only if recorded exit=0, not timed out or capture-limited, original complete, verified consent and parser success. Authentic PARTIAL/ACQUISITION_ERROR nonzero maps PARTIAL/SOURCE_INCOMPLETE per approved O1 rule.
expected.negative: Refuse wrong/missing target, forged command, missing/upstream inventory, bad witness, wrong original ordinal, stderr-only claimed complete, nonzero captured contradiction, malformed UTF-8, controls, oversized rows, forged profile grammar, raw tamper, extra fabricated device read.
expected.bounds: Input max 1MiB; max 4096 lines, max 8192 chars per line; no host/device reads by parser. All original bytes remain preserved.
expected.limits: Version-dependent feature decoding remains opaque; optical command may wake media when actually consented (not executed by fixtures); this is not on-target device verification.

independent_assurance: AI-authored oracles are source-first but not independent human/third-party review; owner gate acceptance not claimed.
